text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I offered the fine wine of victory to the 
Goddess of Victory. Yet, my archrival, 
just how strong will you become?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
She declared her entry in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). That's my beloved archrival for 
you! Then Trainer! We shall also—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nay! The Trainer had already accepted the 
challenge. What an impatient mentor. I 
wanted to take on the challenge too—the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
